title: Serve the App Locally
description: A tiny local web server that lets you open the chess coach over http instead of file, because browsers restrict fetch from file pages.

steps.description: Start Python's built-in web server on port 8000 from the folder that contains `chess-ai-coach.html`. The page says browsers restrict `fetch` from `file://` pages, so you serve the folder over `http://` instead.

Then open `http://localhost:8000/chess-ai-coach.html` in the browser. The page says to leave the provider set to Local only and play a few moves, because the board enforces full chess rules and the opponent replies with no AI and no API key.
